name: Cutting Edge
source:
Holly is a troubled robot, to say the least. And a complicated love-hate relationship with the sport that saved their life -- figure skating -- isn't always enough to keep the dark thoughts at bay, especially when some of the other skaters don't think too highly of mechanical beings.

But when the annual Snowflake Cup comes to their home rink, they find they may have a shot at proving their skills to those who doubt them most; including themselves. With the support of a cyborg who always seems to know what to say, can Holly overcome their self doubt and anxiety in time to sweep the judges off their feet?
